recipe.name: Smoked Murabba
recipe.description: A tart and savory sour balanced by deep citrus sweetness and an evocative, smoldering smokiness.
steps: Add the smoked orange marmalade, freshly squeezed lime juice, and vodka into a cocktail shaker.
Stir gently to break up and dissolve the marmalade into the liquid.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously until well-chilled.
Double-strain through a fine-mesh sieve into an ice-filled rocks glass.
recipe.serving: Serve immediately over a large clear ice block.
